pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karonti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karissanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karothāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.12: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.14.1: na udake uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.15: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānā bhikkhū udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi kātuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.3: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi kātuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.5: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.6.1: na udake agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.7: na udake agilānena uccāro vā passāvo vā kheḷo vā kātabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.8: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karoti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
